source_boundary: Dirty source checkout; per-file hashes identify bytes. No reference module or script was imported/executed. No private installation data, configuration, credentials or browser sessions were accessed.
scope: Every non-hidden, non-bytecode file below scripts, without following directory symlinks. Source aliases, generated/vendor resources, dependency manifests and host templates are explicit entries.

role_meanings.external-helper: Preserve the configured authenticated Obsidian/Zotero action and its exact intent, target, identity and receipt semantics.
role_meanings.helper-build: Build the retained helper; this is not a separate user capability.
role_meanings.generated-helper: Account for the generated executable helper together with its source and build dependency.
role_meanings.vendor-dependency: Account for the dependency and license used by a retained helper; no separate user action is implied.
role_meanings.bootstrap: Replace personal host deployment with app-managed or explicitly configured lifecycle/setup while preserving the supported outcome.
role_meanings.acquisition-helper: Preserve configured publisher/news acquisition, authentication continuity and material/error outcomes without copying private sessions into public source.
role_meanings.diagnostic: Account for useful acquisition diagnostics; source presence is not a live provider check.
role_meanings.host-projection: Preserve source/catalog/reader outcomes through native NNW and migration, adapting literal FreshRSS installation coupling.
role_meanings.build-asset: Preserve renderer/filter behavior through the native implementation; no extra script button is required.
role_meanings.material-validation: Preserve material/fidelity diagnostics and required integrity rules, with personal language preferences remaining configurable.
role_meanings.catalog-scope: Preserve bounded passive catalog discovery/import/archive and verified scope changes separately from AI processing.
role_meanings.metadata-recovery: Preserve official exact-identity abstract/category recovery, distinct from body acquisition and scoring.
role_meanings.classification: Preserve bounded topic/taxonomy changes and verification while making personal choices configurable.
role_meanings.image-assets: Preserve image ownership/catalog/authorization/readback scope; component wiring and remote bytes require separate evidence.
role_meanings.output-maintenance: Preserve explicit historical formatting/lint maintenance without silent rewriting or imposing imported language preferences on new prompts.
role_meanings.note-reconciliation: Preserve guarded note/bibliography updates and exact parent/version/ownership, without replacing current authored work.
role_meanings.cleanup: Preserve reviewed scope, independent backup, eligibility, receipts and bounded recoverable outcomes; no automatic cleanup or purge.
role_meanings.body-ownership: Preserve explicit body/Raw authority, backed-up repair/reset/reconciliation and exact rollback boundaries.
role_meanings.operation-recovery: Preserve contradictory/partial/completed operation distinctions and conditional release without implicit rerun.
role_meanings.migration-component: Account for the planner, identity, adapter, staged writer, backup, receipt or compatibility component in verified migration; preserve its actual source gates.

evidence_boundary: File/metadata inventory and candidate ticket bindings only. This does not establish that every file is an active user feature, audit behavior, implement a port, or prove production use. Owning tickets must inspect callers/contracts and account for retained outcomes. A main/argparse probe does not establish activation.
